name: Supported rubric dimensions
guard: Null rating must not be counted; count is NOT confidence

name: Overall qualitative rating
formula: if not reviewed or any null -> Insufficient evidence; else any Weak -> Weak; else both Strong -> Strong; else Moderate

name: Terrain-first ranking
formula: rank only reviewed & both rated; sort by (-ordinal(terrain),-ordinal(geology), pair_id)

name: Positive-East 0-360 to signed longitude
guard: For display only; do NOT treat Moon/Mars as Earth WGS84

name: Local slope from projected DEM
guard: dx/dy expressed in meters, same effective support, valid mask

name: Local relief
guard: Same physically meaningful footprint; within-body datum only

name: Local roughness as population std
guard: Use fixed radius and common physical support; NOT categorical terrain rating

name: Valid fraction
guard: total >0, quality and NoData masks applied

name: Channel density
guard: Same channel detection threshold and mapping support

name: Published full-fan area ratio (context only)
guard: Approx 15.38 is whole-unit SCALE RATIO, NOT an analog quality score

name: Experimental NASA 2010 trafficability zone
formula: classify maximum hazard zone from NASA TM Table6 with soil mapping
guard: 2010 hypothetical trial only; does NOT predict spacecraft or rover safe passage

name: Experimental weighted metric similarity (OFF by default)
guard: No default tolerances/weights; never report automatically; not valid for materials categories
